profile_text.body:
Vanta is a for-profit startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, that describes itself as automating the complex and time-consuming process of security compliance certification. The company's platform targets compliance frameworks including SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, PCI, GDPR, and others, and the site says it can get organizations audit-ready in weeks rather than months through continuous monitoring and automated evidence collection.

The company's core product, also called Vanta, is categorized as a Finance and Legal AI tool and combines compliance management, risk tracking, and audit automation on a single platform. The site highlights a Vanta agent that drafts policies, completes security questionnaires, and flags issues, and positions the product toward startup founders, security leaders, and CISOs who want to scale compliance programs without adding headcount. A third-party MCP server, listed under the name co.vantaj/mcp-server, provides uptime monitoring capabilities including management of monitors, heartbeats, incidents, and status pages.

The held facts note 175 items of legal exposure associated with California, though no specific cases are recorded in the available data.
